text: Gary Downie, the Chief Capital Officer, TTC will provide a status update to the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee on the delivery of the Easier Access Phase III Program. The Easier Access Phase III Program is an important part of the Toronto Transit Commission’s Multi-Year Accessibility Plan and the program provides an accessible path from street level, buses and streetcars, to subway platforms for all remaining stations not currently accessible.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
